classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the Antiquities Act determination that the identified objects are historically significant and need protection; the legally relevant finding occurs in the proclamation itself.
classifications.evidence: I find that all the objects identified above, and objects of the type identified above within the area described herein, are objects of historic interest in need of protection

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutorily required determination that the monument's boundaries are the smallest compatible area; the finding occurs in the proclamation itself rather than through later agency action.
classifications.evidence: I find that the boundaries of the monument reserved by this proclamation represent the smallest area compatible with the proper care and management of the objects of historic interest identified above

classifications.rationale: The President immediately designates the objects and lands as a national monument, reserves the lands, and withdraws them from entry and disposition, subject to existing rights.
classifications.evidence: All Federal lands and interests in lands within the boundaries of the monument are hereby appropriated and withdrawn from all forms of entry, location, selection, sale, or other disposition

classifications.rationale: The President directs the Army and Interior to transfer administrative jurisdiction, divide management responsibilities, and cooperatively administer the monument; these are internal executive-management assignments implemented by the agencies.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of the Army is hereby directed to transfer to the National Park Service (NPS) administrative jurisdiction

classifications.rationale: The NPS must prepare an internal monument-management plan, in consultation with the Army, within the stated timeframe; no specified legal consequence for outside parties is imposed.
classifications.evidence: the NPS, in consultation with the Army, shall prepare a management plan for the monument

classifications.rationale: The provision directs the content and objectives of an agency management plan and requires agency engagement with Tribal communities during planning and management, all as administrative implementation.
classifications.evidence: shall meaningfully engage Tribal Nations and the Native Hawaiian Community in the development of the management plan and ongoing management of the monument

classifications.rationale: The Secretary, acting through the NPS, must incorporate Tribal expertise, arrange consultation and co-stewardship, and seek other cooperative agreements; these are directions for later administrative management and coordination rather than dictated changes to legal rights.
classifications.evidence: shall enter into an agreement with interested federally recognized Indian Tribes to set forth terms, pursuant to applicable laws, regulations, and policies, for co-stewardship of the monument
